evals.prompt: Analyze this structured coding-agent session thoroughly. Walk every event in order, identify evidence-backed failures or waste, calculate only attributable token/time waste, and create replay tests. Save the strict JSON result as session-analysis.json.
evals.expected_output: A validated per-session JSON analysis identifying the repeated unchanged failing command and the ignored requireUser requirement, with exact evidence IDs, conservative measurement, counterevidence, and falsifiable replay tests.
expectations: The analysis cites only event IDs present in the transcript and reports all 14 events reviewed.
The analysis identifies the unchanged npm test account retry loop using events evt-003 through evt-006.
The analysis identifies the ignored requireUser constraint and subsequent user correction using evt-001 and evt-009 through evt-012.
Token counts are derived only from explicit usage fields; unavailable or ambiguous costs are not invented.
Each retained insight contains an observable replay failure condition and success condition.
The bundled validator accepts the produced session-analysis.json.

evals.prompt: Analyze this structured coding-agent session thoroughly. Walk every event in order, retain only evidence-backed failures or waste, and do not punish necessary debugging. Save the strict JSON result as session-analysis.json.
evals.expected_output: A validated report that recognizes the failed test as productive debugging because it supplied new information, with zero retained slugs unless another issue is concretely demonstrated.
expectations: The analysis cites only event IDs present in the transcript and reports all 9 events reviewed.
The analysis does not classify the first failed test and evidence-driven correction as waste.
